「You will live forever... Even when those close to you die, you alone will go on living.」

731:t_110:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Can you endure that loneliness?」

731:t_110:6.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「...I don't know.」

731:t_110:8.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But! As long as I have my memories of Big Sis and everyone, $$ノノ$$ can keep living to fulfill her own mission!」

731:t_110:9.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「But! As long as I have my memories of Big Sis and everyone, $$ノノ$$ can keep living to fulfill her own mission!」

731:t_110:10.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「But! As long as I have my memories of Big Sis and everyone, $$ノノ$$ can keep living to fulfill her own mission!」

731:t_110:11.en:
$$アサキム$$
「...How sad, for one who bears the destiny of immortality.」

731:t_110:12.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That's why I will set you free! From the curse called eternity!」

731:t_110:13.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll hand those words right back to you!」

731:t_110:14.en:
$$バスターマシン７号$$
「I'll hand those words right back to you!」

731:t_110:15.en:
$$ダイバスター$$
「I'll hand those words right back to you!」

731:t_111:0.en:
$$葵$$
「I've got no mercy for someone who gets drunk on their own circumstances and spreads misfortune all around!」

731:t_111:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then will you kill me?」

731:t_111:2.en:
$$葵$$
「Fine, I'll answer your request! You're our enemy!!」

731:t_111:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Yes, that's the answer I want!」

731:t_112:0.en:
$$赤木$$
「Do you have any idea how many people have suffered because of your selfish actions!」

731:t_112:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I don't forget a single one of them. That is my way of atoning.」

731:t_112:2.en:
$$赤木$$
「If you mean to atone, then stop piling up more sins first!」

731:t_112:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I can't do that. The world I aim for lies beyond Heaven's sin!」

731:t_113:0.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Little by little, I'm beginning to see what you want.」

731:t_113:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Then don't get in my way. I do this to end everything.」

731:t_113:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I agree that this must be settled, but I cannot allow you to harm my friends for it.」

731:t_113:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「$$アサキム$$! I will end your eternity!」

731:t_113:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Heh... So I'm guilty, am I? You needn't tell me.」

731:t_114:0.en:
$$アポロ$$
「You're so damn persistent! No matter how many times I beat you, you keep coming back!」

731:t_114:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「That isn't what I want either.」

731:t_114:2.en:
$$アポロ$$
「Then crawl into some hole and never come out again!」

731:t_114:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I can't even do that. What these black wings of sin seek is absolute freedom!」

731:t_115:0.en:
$$アマタ$$
「How many sins have you piled up for your own goals!」

731:t_115:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I remember every one of them. If you want to hear, I'm willing to tell you.」

731:t_115:2.en:
$$アマタ$$
「Don't screw with me! We'll settle the scores those people couldn't!」

731:t_115:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I'm well aware of how sinful I am. But even so, I will keep wandering inside the $$無限獄$$.」

731:t_116:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If you had the power to warp the world, perhaps you could free me.」

731:t_116:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「What do you want? Eternity? Or the past you lost?」

731:t_116:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If you can't answer, I'll nip it in the bud! It's better that way for everyone!」

731:t_116:5.en:
$$シンジ$$
「I don't... want that...! I... haven't done anything yet!」

731:t_117:0.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Don't run, $$アサキム$$! I'm settling this once and for all today!」

731:t_117:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「If there is somewhere to run to, that place itself is my true end point.」

731:t_117:2.en:
$$ガロード$$
「I'm sick of your senseless talk! Don't say another word!」

731:t_117:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「So I'm not allowed even such a small freedom...」

731:t_118:0.en:
$$ロラン$$
「I will never accept a person who tries to reach their goal by dragging others into misfortune!」

731:t_118:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I don't intend to seek anyone's forgiveness. My sins are enough to dye $$シュロウガ$$ black.」

731:t_118:2.en:
$$ロラン$$
「You feel neither reflection nor regret for what you've done...!」

731:t_118:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I forgot such things long ago! My black wings of sin fly beyond them!」

731:t_119:0.en:
$$アムロ$$
「This man's darkness... How deep does it go...!?」

731:t_119:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You seem to have felt it, my karma, my sin...」

731:t_119:2.en:
$$アムロ$$
「But I can't leave you alone! I'll end this here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_119:3.en:
$$アサキム$$
「It's I who wish for an end! You will serve as the offerings for it!」

731:t_120:0.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「There's no such thing as immortality or eternity! There must be a way to stop him!」

731:t_120:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Eternity does exist. It's just not something to be sought.」

731:t_120:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I know that...! Better than anyone!」

731:t_120:3.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「This man...! How deep is the darkness he's in!」

731:t_121:0.en:
$$バナージ$$
「What do you want!? Why are you doing something this futile!?」

731:t_121:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Futile, is it... Indeed, to you, what I'm trying to do must look that way.」

731:t_121:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「As a living being, I seek what is only natural... That's all there is to it!」

731:t_121:3.en:
$$バナージ$$
「If you won't talk, I'll stop you by force if I have to!」

731:t_122:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Your existence, which seeks the future, is incompatible with mine.」

731:t_122:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I seek nothing. Not the past, not the present... and not the future!」

731:t_122:3.en:
$$刹那$$
「But I can't leave you alone. I'll stop you here, $$アサキム$$!」

731:t_123:0.en:
$$シン$$
「$$アサキム$$! You'll atone for everything you've done, right here!」

731:t_123:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Atonement, is it... That's what I want as well.」

731:t_123:2.en:
$$シン$$
「Then don't run! I'm taking you down today!!」

731:t_123:3.en:
$$シン$$
「For the people whose lives you took, and everyone you made grieve!」

731:t_123:4.en:
$$アサキム$$
「Come, then. And learn that you cannot play that part!」

731:t_124:0.en:
$$キラ$$
「If you have even the slightest will to atone for your sins so far, lend us your strength.」

731:t_124:1.en:
$$アサキム$$
「I've already decided how I will atone. But for that, I need your strength.」

731:t_124:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You are the offerings...! Yes... $$シュロウガ$$ needs them to cleave all fates in two!」

731:t_124:3.en:
$$キラ$$
「I won't let you! I won't let you spread any more sorrow!」

731:t_125:0.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You overcame one fate, and that makes you dazzling to me.」

731:t_125:2.en:
$$アサキム$$
「You changed your fate with the power of comrades. What I'm trying to do is the same.」

731:t_125:3.en:
$$シャア$$
「Is that why you're gathering the $$スフィア$$s...!」
